rows.magnitude: COAL_BIT +19.73 / +12.74 / +16.72 TWh (share +2.1 / +1.4 / +1.8 pp; band about ±8 TWh), FAIL
rows.object: In-merit loading response of bituminous coal. The keeper runs COAL_BIT at 0.98 / 0.95 / 0.99 of available cap in 2019-21 against CAMPD 0.90 / 0.88 / 0.91, and backs off below real in 2023/24, which therefore pass by cancellation, not by match. Real coal sat out multi-day slack spells (11-15 stops per unit-year, median 79-101 h) while still offering below its own measured going cost; a cost-based, hourly-independent LP dispatches every in-money MW at its offer.
rows.evidence: DRAFT-closeout-pjm-2-frontier-text-2026-10-03 statement 1b, restated on this keeper. NEXT-17 (load carries 80-100 % of the gap), NEXT-24 (within-plant, year-specific), NEXT-27 (online_frac dispatch-inert), NEXT-28 (no-load committed floor 10-50x short, R-30), NEXT-29 (floor is not the operand), NEXT-30 (overstatement vs merit position; the 2023/24 cancellation). NEXT-31 AVAILABILITY: the three committed CAMPD extracts carry about 95 % of COAL_BIT unit-dark MWh; the uncovered rest is depleted in tight and S2 hours, the economic-shutdown signature, so a window for it is rule-13 pinning (statement 1a's rule-14 route closed, no repair). NEXT-32 COMMITMENT: keeper runs 3.5-5.3 TWh/yr in uncovered real-dark coal, 0.27-0.28 of the overage, 0.92 price-cleared, floor share 0.095. NEXT-33 PRICE: keeper zone price in dark spells only +0.3 / +1.9 / +1.2 $/MWh over real zonal DA; not year-discriminating. NEXT-34 OFFER: keeper COAL_BIT offer is below measured going cost in 2019-21 (-7.4 / -8.6 / -3.0) and further below in the 2023/24 controls (-11.1 / -8.7); PJM's own LONG_RUN offers sit below going cost on 0.69-0.91 of the weight. closeout-PJM-decommit (R-55): friction posture adds coal; three-part commitment with measured no-load removes 2.09 / 3.34 / 1.21 TWh against bars 5.86 / 2.37 / 4.36 and 6.09 / 4.52 TWh in the 2023/24 controls; nested and netload floors under the bar; NOT CHARTERED, R-56 'Leave open'. closeout-PJM-w2: the §3.6 queue is exhausted.
rows.levers: PJM shard: committed_band_measured_basis R; gas_offer_margin_anchor_vintage R (pjm-169, R-13); measured_offer_surface R; pjm_replacement_cost_fuel R (NEXT-13); mustrun_commitment_feasibility_clip R; coal_committed_nested_on_mustrun R and commitment_floor_window_netload R (U to R at R-56); coal_passthrough_sigmoids K (gas_mid re-centre R, pjm-h7); offer_curve_by_group K (the rule-1 band: no year-uniform operand, NEXT-34); coal_drop_pof K; unit_outage_short_windows K; reserve_pergen K (L1 coal reserve membership a no-op, wave-1 0c); coal_fuel_inventory U and coal_nameplate_summer_derate U (unreachable on this object).
rows.why: Every channel on COAL_BIT 2019-21 (availability, commitment, price, offer level) is censused at zero LP and none discriminates 2019-21 from 2023/24. The real fleet's price-flat loading and slack decommitment under below-cost offers is commitment and offer conduct with no measured, forward-reproducible input (rules 13, 24); any form that removes the fail-year coal removes as much or more in the controls.
rows.reopen: Unit-identified PJM offer or real-time commitment / self-schedule records; an online-gated synchronized-reserve mechanism that clears rule 19; or a decommitment form whose zero-LP reach separates 2019-21 from 2023/24.
